instructions: This is the on-device user interface for a beer/wine brewing fermentation temperature controller. Use terminology appropriate for homebrewing and beer/wine making. The general model employed by the controller is to have a fermenter (bucket, conical, etc.) placed inside of a refrigerator (or other chamber that can be cooled) to indirectly control the temperature of the beer. The fridge is turned on/off to control the temperature of the air inside in order to tightly control the temperature of the beer that is fermenting. There is also support for toggling a pump on/off to circulate glycol around the beer.

glossary.controller: The device the UI is installed on. A temperature controller, such as a BrewPi
glossary.Fermentrack: A web-based interface the controller can optionally be connected to, which will both log data sent by the controller and can control the controller
glossary.profile: temperature control profile - a schedule of temperatures
glossary.actuator: Another word for relay or switch. A control point for either cooling or heating
glossary.Tilt Hydrometer: a bluetooth hydrometer which sits in the fermenting beer and detects both the gravity of the beer and the beer's temperature
glossary.Inkbird: a brand of bluetooth temperature sensors
glossary.Gravity: specific gravity - the measure of sugar content in fermenting liquid
glossary.OG: original gravity - the starting gravity of the liquid
